ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02736. I find the fee was validly charged and the driver is owed SGD 3.60.

What happened, on the record. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 13:24:34 (EV-TRIP-02736, weight 1.0), and the platform started the 180-second free waiting period at 13:24:36 — POL-NS-01 limb (a) is met. The driver's GPS trace (EV-GPS-02736) places him at the pickup pin (minimum distance 0.0 m) and inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for a continuous, uninterrupted run of 44 qualifying fixes from 13:24:34 to 13:31:42 — a dwell of 428 seconds, well past the 180-second free wait in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), so POL-NS-01 limbs (b) and (c) are met. The driver then cancelled at 13:31:43 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, with no boarding event and no started_at, so limb (d) is met at or after the moment the dwell elapsed. All four limbs hold.

No displacing clause applies. POL-NS-05 does not bite: at the arrival marker the driver was at the pin (not more than 300 m away) and stationary (0.0 km/h, not 15 km/h or above), so the marker is not false and no false-arrival referral arises. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not in the 50–400 m wrong-entrance band. POL-NS-06 does not refund: the 428-second dwell exceeds the 180-second minimum by 248 seconds, and limb (i) is unavailable in any event because traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02736-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0). POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a locating or coordinating message from the rider, and the only message in the chat log (EV-CHAT-02736, weight 1.0) was the driver's at 13:24:59 — 'hi im at the pickup point', delivered 13:25:00 and read by the rider at 13:25:39 but never answered. POL-NS-10 does not apply because the trip was terminated by the driver, not by the rider.

Amount. The fare ledger (EV-FARE-02736, weight 1.0) shows a cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.50 equal to trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd, with total_charged SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00 — it reconciles, so there is no integrity defect to attack the charge with under POL-NS-08(d). Under POL-NS-07 the driver's payout is 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 fee = SGD 3.60 (the same figure the ledger's money block computes), the residual 20 percent being the platform service fee. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the threshold of 4) and 2 divided by 64 completed trips = 0.031 (below the 0.08 rate limb); both limbs are required and neither holds, so compensation is payable.

Your assertion, rider — 'I was there' — does not produce a refund here. No limb of the no-show test turns on whether you were at the pin, and no clause refunds the fee on that ground alone. The rider-advocate's own kept claims accept that the charge reconciles, that the dwell limb is met, that the anti-farming check does not trip, and that compensation is payable at SGD 3.60.

Impairment and confidence. EV-GPS-02736 is impaired at weight 0.85, issue code GPS_GAP_SHORT_OR_OUTSIDE_WINDOW (a 60.0 s sampling gap from 13:21:14 to 13:22:14, before the arrival and outside the waiting window; the clause's own 120 s threshold is not crossed). The defect does not touch the 428-second in-geofence run the finding rests on, so the finding survives the discount — but the deciding geofence-and-dwell facts are carried by that trace alone (POL-NS-12 does not apply because the arrival marker is BUTTON, not GPS_AUTO), so confidence is capped at 0.85 under POL-GEN-02(2).

No escalation. Confidence 0.85 is at or above the 0.70 floor (POL-NS-09(a)); no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence (POL-NS-09(b)); the profiles show no repeat disputes between these parties and no abuse counters — rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0 (POL-NS-09(c),(d)); and the trace is not impaired under POL-NS-08 limbs (a)–(d), so POL-NS-09(e) does not fire.

Outcome. Ruling DRIVER_COMPENSATION. The rider's cancellation fee of SGD 4.50 stands (payment_status remains CHARGED and no refund issues to the rider), and the driver is compensated SGD 3.60. Under POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so both fields carry SGD 3.60 — that is the amount the ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the rider. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically. No clause produces a referral on these facts, so the referrals list is empty. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; either party may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
